about: The models, sky and ground for the walk in "Rockets and Horses" (assets/js/walk/). tools/gauge-assets.mjs makes what's missing: each model by Meshy text-to-3D (preview, then a refine with PBR textures), or image-to-3D from `image` where words got the shape wrong (a stand-in drawn by tools/model-ref.mjs), then shrunk with gltf-transform into assets/models/gauge/<name>.glb (textures at `textureSize`, 1024 but for the horse, which is seen closest, so a phone holds them all; `simplify`: keep that share of the triangles, for a model drawn many times); the sky (`sky`, a day with nothing but sky, and `dusk`, for the dark theme) and the textures for the ground and the eras' buildings from Poly Haven (CC0; the first id in each list that exists) into assets/images/gauge/. Run by .github/workflows/models.yml, which has the MESHY_API_KEY secret, whenever this file changes on a branch. `fit` says how gauge.js puts a model in its stand-in's place: turned by rotateY (radians) first, then scaled so its size along `along` (x, the track; y, up) matches the stand-in's, or with `wheels`, so its wheels sit on the rails (or in the ruts).
style: Photorealistic, real-world materials and weathering, physically based textures, natural daylight colours, no text or logos, game-ready, a single object on its own with no ground or base

horse.prompt: A bay draught horse standing still in profile, dark brown coat with black mane, tail and lower legs, a plain leather collar and harness, no rider, no cart, head forward, 1.6 m at the withers
horse.texture: Real horse hair coat, glossy bay brown with black points, worn dark leather harness with brass buckles

chariot.texture: Photorealistic ancient Roman racing chariot: oiled oak floor, rail, pole and spokes, the curved wall painted deep red with worn ochre trim and scuffs, dark hammered iron tyres and fittings, dust from the track

roman-cart.texture: Photorealistic ancient Roman goods cart (plaustrum): two solid wheels of thick rough oak planks held by a cross bar, dark iron tyres and nails, a low box bed of weathered rough-sawn oak, worn shafts, dust and dried mud on the wheels

wagon.prompt: A medieval English four-wheeled farm wagon loaded with loose hay, wooden spoked wheels, shafts forward, no animal
wagon.texture: Weathered grey-brown oak, dried golden hay, iron tyres, mud

chaldron.texture: Photorealistic 18th century English coal chaldron wagon: a tapering hopper of coal-blackened oak planks bound with dark iron bands, heaped with lumps of shiny black coal, a heavy oak frame, small rusty cast-iron flanged wheels, a long oak brake lever, coal dust everywhere

locomotive.texture: Photorealistic replica of Stephenson's Rocket of 1829: a glossy yellow-painted iron boiler with black iron bands, a tall black iron chimney, a polished copper firebox at the back, big wooden spoked driving wheels painted yellow with dark iron tyres, black iron cylinders and rods, soot; the tender behind of oiled oak carrying a dark oak water barrel with iron hoops, black iron wheels

boxcar.prompt: A modern North American freight railroad boxcar, long and boxy with a sliding side door, ribbed steel sides, two four-wheel trucks with steel wheels
boxcar.texture: Faded boxcar-red painted steel, rust streaks, road grime, dark steel trucks and wheels, no lettering

booster-car.texture: Photorealistic: one Space Shuttle solid rocket booster segment, a plain matte white painted steel cylinder with grey steel joint rings at each end and no fins or nose, lying in dark steel cradles on a long dark weathered steel railroad flatcar with rust, grime and black steel wheels

shuttle.prompt: The Space Shuttle launch stack: the white orbiter with black heat-shield tiles on its belly and nose, mounted on the side of the large orange external fuel tank, with two white solid rocket boosters on either side of the tank, standing upright, no launch tower, no flames
shuttle.texture: White orbiter with black thermal tiles, rust-orange spray-foam insulation on the external tank, white boosters with grey rings
